profile.reading: Evocative IAD1 is a data center in Reston, Virginia, in the Washington DC metro area. Evocative's own dedicated page for this facility, fetched directly from evocative.com, confirms the address 1807 Michael Faraday Court, Reston, Virginia 20190, matching this row's previously reverse geocoded address and upgrading it to an operator confirmed source. The operator's own page describes the facility as a Tier III edge data center with 2 x 200 kVA redundant utility transformers, for roughly 400 kilovolt amperes of total capacity, and 14 x 30 ton CRAC cooling units, a smaller footprint than Evocative's larger core facilities in New Jersey and California already on file elsewhere in this registry, consistent with an edge site designed for low latency access into the Washington DC metro rather than a hyperscale campus. The operator's own page lists compliance with SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SSAE 18, SOC 1, SOC 2, and ISAE 3402 standards, and states the facility is carrier neutral. Square footage and a specific year opened were not published on the operator's own page for this building. Evocative describes itself elsewhere on its site as a global infrastructure provider operating data center, bare metal, network, cloud, and managed services across 24 data centers in 14 strategically located metros and 32 points of presence, with this Reston building serving the Washington DC metro alongside other Evocative locations in California, New Jersey, Arizona, Georgia, Massachusetts, Texas, and Washington already on file elsewhere in this registry. Reston, Virginia sits near the Dulles Technology Corridor, one of the largest data center concentrations in the world by capacity, anchored by nearby Ashburn, Virginia and its dense cluster of Equinix, Digital Realty, and other hyperscale and colocation campuses that collectively handle a large share of North American internet traffic.
